An Ordinance

[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I 1st June, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
1-6-2000.--The following Ordinance made
by the President is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Civil Servants
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Substitution of section 13 Act lxxi of 1973

ORDINANCE XX OF 2000
CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I 1st June, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
1-6-2000.--The following Ordinance made
by the President is hereby published for general information:
2. Substitution of section 13,
Act LXXI of 1973.--In the . Civil Servants Act, 1973 (LXXI of 1973), for
section 13 the following shall be substituted namely:--
"13. Retirement from
service.--(1) A civil servant shall retire from service-- .
(i) On such date after he has
completed twenty-five years of service qualifying for pension or other
retirement benefits as the competent Authority may, in public interest, direct;
or
(ii) where no direction is given
under clause (i), on the completion of the sixtieth year of his age.
(2) No direction under clause
(i). of subsection (1) shall be made until the civil servant has been informed
in writing of the grounds on which it, is proposed to make the direction, and
has been given a reasonable opportunity of showing cause against the said
direction.
Explanation.--In this
section, 'competent Authority' means the appointing Authority prescribed in
rule 6 of the Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1973.
